title: React UI library selection catalog
summary: Selection reference for React Flow, dnd-kit, TanStack Table, Embla Carousel, and Tiptap. Use it to discover an established React UI library for node editors, drag-and-drop, data tables, carousels, or rich-text editing; it is not a blanket instruction to install any package.
incompatible_when: There is no concrete product requirement for the interaction the library owns.
A static or semantic HTML implementation meets the requirement with materially less client-side code.
The project cannot provide keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, and responsive behavior appropriate to the selected interaction.
The proposed editor would handle regulated, untrusted, or user-authored content without an approved persistence, sanitization, authorization, and review design.
procedure: Define the required interaction and acceptance criteria before selecting a library.
Choose only the library whose responsibility matches the requirement; do not install this catalog as a bundle.
Recheck the current stable package version, peer dependencies, license, framework guidance, and security advisories at adoption time.
For Next.js, keep interactive widgets in the smallest practical client component and preserve server rendering for surrounding content.
Design keyboard, screen-reader, focus, reduced-motion, touch, and responsive behavior before implementation.
Measure the resulting client bundle and verify the real interaction with automated and manual tests before retaining the dependency.
verification: Confirm the selected package and any companion packages belong to compatible stable release lines using the live npm registry.
Verify the implementation against the selected library's current official documentation and accessibility guidance.
Run the target repository's dependency, type, unit, accessibility, browser, build, and bundle checks required by its local instructions.
Remove the dependency if the product requirement can be met more safely or simply without it.
rollback: Remove an unused or rejected dependency and its imports, styles, generated UI, and lockfile entries using the target repository's package manager.
Restore the prior semantic/static UI and rerun the target repository's canonical verification.
Keep this record at candidate status, or delete it before promotion if its evidence becomes stale or incorrect.

libraries.name: React Flow
avoid_when: the UI is a simple static flowchart
there is no node or edge editing requirement
integration_notes: With Tailwind CSS 4, import the React Flow stylesheet after the Tailwind stylesheet in the global CSS entry.
Give the React Flow parent explicit width and height.
Server rendering is supported in React Flow 12, but server-rendered edges require known node dimensions and handle positions.
accessibility_notes: Preserve keyboard selection, movement, deletion, focus, and clear labels for nodes, handles, controls, and edges.

libraries.name: dnd-kit

packages.name: @dnd-kit/helpers
packages.purpose: Optional helpers such as move for sortable state.

avoid_when: native form controls or simple move up/down buttons are sufficient
the interaction lacks a keyboard-equivalent design
integration_notes: Use the current @dnd-kit/react DragDropProvider API for new work.
Treat tutorials based on legacy @dnd-kit/core, DndContext, SortableContext, or arrayMove as migration references rather than the new default API.
Do not disable default keyboard behavior accidentally when customizing sensors.
accessibility_notes: Provide focusable drag activators, keyboard operation, contextual instructions, and live announcements tailored to the application.

libraries.name: TanStack Table
avoid_when: the data is small and static
a semantic HTML table needs no interactive state
a fully styled enterprise grid is required out of the box
integration_notes: TanStack Table is headless: the application owns semantic markup, responsive behavior, styles, empty states, loading states, and controls.
Prefer stable row identifiers and lift only the state that must be shared with URLs, servers, or other components.
Use server-side sorting, filtering, or pagination when the data volume or authorization boundary requires it.
accessibility_notes: Render semantic table structure where appropriate and provide announced sort state, labelled controls, focus behavior, and an alternative responsive presentation when needed.

libraries.name: Embla Carousel

packages.name: embla-carousel-accessibility
packages.adoption_warning: The observed accessibility plugin is a v9 release candidate and must not be mixed with the stable v8 React wrapper. Recheck for a matched stable release or implement the required semantics and controls locally.

avoid_when: fewer than three meaningful items exist
a grid exposes content more clearly
the carousel would hide essential information
integration_notes: Keep navigation controls outside the draggable viewport to avoid interaction conflicts.
Use stable dimensions to prevent layout shift and preserve native links or buttons inside slides.
Install optional plugins only from a release line compatible with the selected Embla core/wrapper.
accessibility_notes: Provide explicit previous/next controls, slide position or status, labelled regions, focus management, touch and keyboard access, and zero-duration behavior for prefers-reduced-motion. Avoid autoplay by default.

libraries.name: Tiptap
avoid_when: there is no authenticated authoring or persistence workflow
plain text or Markdown meets the requirement
integration_notes: In Next.js, place the editor in a client component and use immediatelyRender: false to avoid hydration mismatches.
Choose a canonical storage format and define schema migrations before persisting production content.
Treat pasted input and rendered HTML as untrusted; sanitize at the appropriate trust boundary and restrict risky links, media, and extensions.
The open-source editor is MIT licensed, while optional Tiptap Cloud or paid capabilities require separate commercial and data-processing review.
accessibility_notes: The application owns toolbar, menu, textbox, shortcut, focus, contrast, and keyboard accessibility because Tiptap is headless.

evidence.source_repository: Official project documentation and npm registry
